name: codex-rpi-connect
description: Local command and file MCP bridge through the Raspberry Pi Connect browser terminal. Live-device acceptance required.

interface.shortDescription: Run approved commands and manage project files through Connect.
interface.longDescription: Manually authenticated browser sessions, explicit per-operation approvals, bounded foreground command jobs, stdout/stderr capture, cancellation, root-restricted file tools and checksummed terminal transfers. Real Connect compatibility must be validated on an authorized Pi.
defaultPrompt: Help me test my Raspberry Pi Connect device.
